description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the Builder class within the Todaymade\Daux\Tree namespace. It includes various tests for directory and page creation, removal of sorting information from filenames, handling of filenames with Unicode characters, ignoring specified files/folders, and parsing front matter in index files.

classes.name: BuilderTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class testing various functionalities of the Builder class related to directory and page creation, filename processing, and index front matter handling.

methods.name: testRemoveSorting
methods.description: Tests that the removeSortingInformations method correctly strips sorting prefixes from filenames.
